title: Re: SOC 2 - evidence request: background checks & training artifacts
text:
Re: SOC 2 - evidence request: background checks & training artifacts

["From: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@brightwave.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 personnel evidence request - background checks & training

Hi Ava / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. As part of BrightWave's SOC 2 review, our security team has asked for evidence around Redwood's personnel controls. Specifically, could you provide the following by EOD 2025-08-16?

- A summary (high-level) of pre-employment background checks performed (scope: criminal, identity verification, right to work) and % of hires with completed checks in the last 12 months.
- A redacted sample of background check confirmation (example PDF) — we do not need PII, but need format and fields present.
- Current training completion rates (security awareness, data handling, and if applicable, secure coding) by role bucket and a CSV export with anonymized IDs.
- Onboarding and offboarding checklist showing access provisioning and deprovisioning steps.
- Any attestations or internal policy excerpts related to personnel screening and training.

We prefer a ZIP with CSV / PDF artifacts and a one-page transmittal that maps files to the questions in our SIG/SOC 2 checklist. If you need to redact names/emails, please indicate the redaction approach.

Attached is the questionnaire we referenced in the call (just to align scope). Let me know if tighter deadlines are required.

Thanks,
Sana Iqbal
Senior Compliance Manager
BrightWave Health
security@brightwave.com

Attachment: external_questionnaire.pdf (1 page)
", "From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@brightwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 personnel evidence request - background checks & training

Hi Sana — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes and a proposed schedule: 

- We will not provide raw PII. Our delivery will include: redacted sample PDFs (names/emails removed), a CSV with anonymized employee IDs, and a one-page mapping document that points to where each artifact satisfies the SIG items.
- Proposed delivery: preliminary transmittal + subset (training completion CSV + one redacted sample) by 2025-08-13; full package (BG summary, checklist, zipped artifacts) by 2025-08-15.
- If you need legal attestation language or a signed cover letter, please flag and we'll loop Legal.

I'm copying Monica (HR ops) and Mina (security ops) to coordinate exports and redactions. Monica — can you confirm we can produce the training export and the redacted BG sample on the proposed timeline? Mina — we'll need the onboarding/offboarding checklist and the policy excerpt.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: proposed_transmittal_plan.md (outline of files and dates)
", "From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-10T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 personnel evidence request - exports & redaction notes

Ava / Mina — forwarding the task with artifacts attached. Below is what I've prepared and notes on redaction.

Attachments included here for internal review before external sharing:
- training_completion_report.csv — columns: anon_id, role_bucket, course_security_awareness, course_data_handling, course_secure_coding, last_completed_date
- bg_check_summary.pdf — aggregated counts by check type and pass/flag summary (no names)
- onboard_checklist.zip — PDF checklist and a short runbook for provisioning/deprovisioning steps
- redacted_employee_samples.zip — three sample redacted BG confirmations and one redacted hire onboarding form

Redaction approach:
- Replace name/email with stable anon_id (format: RW-XXXX). Dates preserved at month granularity (e.g., 2025-03) to avoid re-identification but keep timeline fidelity.
- Remove candidate SSNs and DOBs from samples; keep the checkbox fields and vendor stamp visible so you can see what was checked.

Notes/asks:
- Jonas: can Legal provide a short cover letter/attestation template we can include?
- Mina: please review the onboarding checklist for any operational redactions needed (access logs references).

I'll stage the zipped package in a restricted Drive folder and share a link once we have sign-off. If BrightWave needs file hashes or a signed delivery, let me know.

Best,
Monica Patel
People Operations Manager
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: training_completion_report.csv, bg_check_summary.pdf, onboard_checklist.zip, redacted_employee_samples.zip
", "From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@brightwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T16:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 personnel evidence request - delivery of redacted package

Hi Sana — attaching the package we discussed. Summary below and shared Drive link.

Summary of deliverables:
- training_completion_report.csv (anonymized IDs, role buckets, course completion flags)
- bg_check_summary.pdf (aggregate counts, pass/flag breakdown)
- onboard_checklist.zip (onboarding/offboarding checklist + runbook)
- redacted_employee_samples.zip (3 redacted BG confirmations + 1 onboarding form)
- transmittal_document.pdf (one-page map of files -> questionnaire items)

Delivery details:
- Shared (restricted) Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExample
- DocuSign attestation link (if you need a signed cover): https://www.docusign.com/abcd1234
- Redaction approach: names/emails replaced with RW-XXXX anon IDs; exact DOBs and SSNs removed; month-level dates retained.

If this looks good, we'll mark the request closed. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the artifacts on Tuesday 2025-08-18.

Thanks for the partnership — let us know if you need any additional mapping to specific SIG control IDs.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: transmittal_document.pdf, package_manifest.txt
"]
